model: binomial GLM on counts, cluster-robust SEs by unit (approx of preregistered binomial GLMM)

beta5_SHC_x_Scov.identification: SIGN-UNSTABLE / NOT IDENTIFIED: cluster-robust GLM gives beta=-0.252, the empirical-logit mixed model gives beta=+0.254 on the same data. Opposite signs from two estimators means the pooled data cannot identify even the direction of this effect, because S_cov varies only across 3 dataset clusters. The covariate-shift evidence in this study is the per-dataset UGR-16 per-class result (nerisbotnet holds, scans collapse under the same S_cov), which this aggregate coefficient cannot capture. Do NOT report a sign for beta5.

identification_note: beta7 (SHC x S_sup) is well identified (NSL sweeps S_sup 0-0.46) and robust: negative and highly significant in BOTH estimators. beta5 (SHC x S_cov) is NOT identified: the two estimators disagree on sign, so it is reported as sign-unstable and the per-dataset UGR result carries the covariate claim. Support shift drives coverage failure; covariate shift is not captured by any aggregate measure.
tooling_deviation: preregistered crossed-RE binomial GLMM approximated by cluster-robust binomial GLM + empirical-logit mixed model; exact glmer to be run in R for camera-ready.
